title: Street setback of 1 m or less: awnings define and give weather protection to entries
text: Development with a primary setback of 1m or less to the street includes awnings that: define and provide weather protection to entries; are integrated into the façade design; are consistent with the streetscape character.
notes: Only the first limb (awnings that define and weather-protect the entries) is tested; the integration and streetscape-consistency limbs are A4.10.5-r1 (judgment). building.street_setback_m is read as the primary street setback here; where it is the secondary street that is smaller, supply the primary street figure.
